other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of the State
Applicant must belong to the State Religious Minority Community
Family income from all sources must be within Rs 96,000 per annum
Each beneficiary must own between 1 acre 20 gunte (approximately 1.5 acres) and 5 acres of dry land
In districts Kodagu, Dakshina Kannada, Udupi, Uttara Kannada, Chikkamagaluru, Shimoga, and Hassan, the minimum land requirement is 1 acre due to limited land availability
Applicant must be a small or marginal farmer
benefits_summary: Provides fully subsidized bore wells, pumps, and electrification to eligible minority small and marginal farmers in rural areas, with financial assistance up to Rs 3.75 Lakhs per project.
